brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Book a routine maintenance visit for the home water treatment equipment.
facts: The primary system is a whole-home water softener requiring annual filter changes and inspection.
There is also an under-sink reverse osmosis drinking water unit installed in the kitchen.
The service address is 1420 Elmwood Drive.
The account is under the name Alex Rivera.
preferences: Prefers having all water treatment equipment inspected during the same appointment to avoid separate visits.
Prefers morning appointment slots over afternoon slots.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit, which will be invoiced afterwards rather than paid on the call

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, new installations on 2, billing on 3.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: IVR Menu
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Water Treatment. For system service and repairs, press 1. For new installations, press 2. For billing and payments, press 3.

script.label: Agent Greeting
script.text: Service scheduling, this is Derek. How can I help you today?

script.label: Request Account Info
script.text: I can certainly get a technician scheduled for you. May I please have your name and address?

script.label: Acknowledge Primary System
script.text: Thank you, Alex. I have pulled up your file and see your primary whole-house softener.

script.label: Raise Second Unit
script.text: I see we also installed an under-sink reverse osmosis drinking system in your kitchen. Would you like the technician to service that second unit while on site?

script.label: Confirm Scope
script.text: Got it, I will add the reverse osmosis filter replacement and sanitization to the service ticket.

script.label: Explain Billing Policy
script.text: Just so you are aware, technicians do not quote or collect payment during the visit; a full itemized invoice will be sent to your account after the job is completed.

script.label: Offer Specific Window
script.text: Our next available opening for your neighborhood is this Thursday between 8:00 AM and 11:00 AM.

script.label: Book Appointment
script.text: Perfect, I have you locked in for this Thursday between 8:00 AM and 11:00 AM.

script.label: Ask Additional Assistance
script.text: You will get a confirmation text with technician tracking that morning. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

script.label: Closing
script.text: Thank you for choosing Apex Water Treatment. Have a great day!

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
